fact: In June 2024 the EDPA issued Enforcement Notice 4/2024 to Liberty Life Swaziland Limited, a warning over a misdirected email disclosing personal information, reported by the firm on 7 November 2023.
title: EDPA-NOTICE 4/2024: Enforcement Notice in Terms of Section 41 of the Eswatini Data Protection Act 2022 - Liberty Life Swaziland Limited
